pages.title: 01 // THE BLUEPRINT ILLUSION
pages.content:
A client asks to see your robot. You send a PDF blueprint.

The client looks at flat lines. They don't see the harmonic drive. They don't see the 11-DOF tactile fingers. They don't see the 60 FPS real-time kinematics. They see wallpaper.

PDFs don't sell industrial robotics. Experiences sell industrial robotics.

Don't show a drawing of a machine. Step inside the factory floor.

pages.title: 02 // 4-STAGE MECHANICAL DECONSTRUCTION
pages.content:
How do you prove precision engineering? You explode the machine in real time.

0% — Fully integrated bipedal chassis. Sleek. Operating at 60 FPS idle.
33% — Outer shell peels away. Structural titanium skeleton exposed.
66% — Harmonic drive motors detach along smooth Bezier curves.
100% — Dexterous 11-DOF hands expand. 1,024 tactile pressure sensors visible.

You don't tell them your motors are precise. You pull the motor out of the casing in front of their eyes.

pages.title: 03 // RAYCASTING TRUTH & HARMONIC KINEMATICS
pages.content:
Hover a laser over a joint node. 1px Cyan wireframe locks in. Depth-of-field blurs the background. Swiss CAD blueprint HUD overlays the surface.

Telemetry stream:
Torque Accuracy: ±0.01mm.
Harmonic Ratio: 1:100.
Max Velocity: 4.5 m/s.

No marketing fluff. Just raw, immutable, 60 FPS mechanical reality.
